{{Quote|Lieutenant Bokete mentioned special forces. Do we know any specifics?|Aves|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bokete''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served as one of [[Aves]]' subordinates during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Boteke discovered that the Empire was preparing to deploy special forces against the trapped [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. He was able to send this report to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aves]] until he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the process of gaining the information. After his death, Aves' [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] allies were able to gain the information on the emitters' location.
